findings.title: No test files among 41 source files
findings.detail: Tests are recognized by path and name conventions (test/, *_test.go, *.spec.ts…). A low ratio means changes are verified by hand, or by tests that live somewhere this report cannot see.

findings.title: 44 exported symbols are never used outside their own file
findings.detail: Of these, 25 are referenced nowhere at all; 19 are used inside their own file and only need to lose `export`. Dead exports widen the surface a change has to consider. Some may be public API used outside this repository; merging.ts has the most (5).

findings.detail: Heavily referenced symbols are the project's vocabulary; renaming or changing their signature touches every caller. Next: Binding (2 files), prop (2 files), equals (2 files) and Field (2 files).
